title: Duplicate evidence
rule: Identical evidence files should be flagged and should not be treated as independent corroboration.

title: Timestamp mismatch
rule: A material mismatch between the reported incident time and evidence metadata should trigger follow-up verification.

title: Contradictory statements
rule: Materially contradictory witness statements should be reconciled before a confident approval.

title: Incomplete evidence
rule: If critical evidence is missing or unreadable, use requires_follow_up rather than guessing.

title: Fraud threshold
rule: Fraudulent should be used only when multiple strong indicators support deliberate manipulation or deception; suspicion alone is insufficient.
